description: Main source file for a micro:bit Pong game implementation using Zephyr RTOS, handling game logic, display, input, and Bluetooth communication.

methods.name: beep
methods.description: Generates a beep sound with specified period using PWM.

methods.name: sound_set
methods.description: Sets the current sound state (idle, paddle hit, wall hit).

methods.name: pong_select
methods.description: Displays selection menu on the micro:bit display.

methods.name: pong_select_change
methods.description: Cycles to the next selection option.

methods.name: pong_select_complete
methods.description: Completes the selection process and triggers callback.

methods.name: game_init
methods.description: Initializes game state, resets positions and variables.

methods.name: check_start
methods.description: Checks timing to start the game based on button presses.

methods.name: game_ended
methods.description: Handles game end, displays win/lose message.

methods.name: game_refresh
methods.description: Main game loop updating ball and paddle positions, handling collisions.

methods.name: pong_ball_received
methods.description: Updates ball position and velocity upon receiving data from Bluetooth.

methods.name: button_pressed
methods.description: Handles button press events for game control and input.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing peripherals, Bluetooth, display, and running game loop.
